name: Sentinelle Médicale
description: Gardien bienveillant parcourant les champs de bataille, ses tendrils de soins cyan s'étendant vers les alliés blessés. Monté sur un exosquelette de récupération, il trie les victimes sur le vif avec une précision clinique tout en continuant de pilonner les ennemis de ses tirs de harpon.

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavily patched industrial space suit built from obsolete mining exoskeleton, reinforced with rusted scrap metal plates, duct tape, exposed cables, and a cracked welding helmet with a plasma‑glowing visor
loadout.arsenal: Improvised kinetic harpoon rifle with exposed copper coils and a built‑in plasma welding torch for close combat, plus a back‑mounted biotech unit that emits glowing cyan healing tendrils

attitude.behavior: Leaning forward, weapon raised, advancing through debris while extending luminous tendrils toward wounded allies, triaging on the fly
attitude.emotion: Fierce determination with a compassionate focus; cold mechanical stare behind visor while selectively healing only the injured

palette_names.name: Rust Orange
palette_names.role: weathered metal accents, rust patches, and fire

palette_names.name: Plasma Blue
palette_names.role: energy emitted by healing tendrils and weapon glow

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic low‑key illumination with strong rim light from plasma impacts, volumetric fog, and a central cyan glow from the healing tendrils; harsh shadows accentuating the gritty industrial environment

scenography.setting: Asteroid waystation crossroads surrounded by corrugated metal walls, exposed piping, and improvised barricades made of shipping containers and scrap; under heavy plasma fire from advancing enemy silhouettes
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Thick smoke billowing, plasma rounds exploding on walls, sparks and debris raining down, glowing cyan healing tendrils weaving through smoke, occasional distant blasts
